title: Hash-pinned Google/Azure word-evidence import
summary: The legacy recovery reviewer requires source-video and prepared-audio SHA-256 bindings absent from the earlier ASR normalizers. Dev2 imports independently acquired Google Speech-to-Text or Azure batch JSON against exactly one planned clip, verifies timestamp and media bounds, and emits customer.agent.transcript.words/0.1 with unverified status.
invariants: Google batch result URIs must resolve unambiguously to the selected clip; do not assign a single unrelated entry as a fallback.
Azure tick offsets are integer 100 ns units; string duration guesses and Google missing offsets fail closed.
The selected work definition must contain exact 64-character lowercase SHA-256 for video and audio, plus valid source timing.
Word start/end offsets remain provider estimates relative to extracted audio start, not sample-exact phoneme truth.
Record SHA-256 of original provider-response bytes. This protects reproducibility, but it does not authenticate the provider.
Reject empty, reversed, out-of-range or nonmonotonic word intervals and invalid confidence.
Output status is RECOGNIZED_UNVERIFIED and asset_authority_granted=false; no customer data disclosure, voice-match or facial identity inference.
No provider requests, credentials, media upload or mesh jobs are executed by the importer.
Web/LDAP/HTTPS permissions and Storage Fabric, Migratable Job and Node Allocation remain separate authoritative components.
procedure: Build the 83 readback definitions from the 227 completed A02 preparations.
Associate one independently acquired Google/Azure response with the exact planned clip and pinned video/audio hashes.
Run src/asr_evidence.py with --plan, --clip, --provider, --response, --output (and --source-uri for exact cloud mapping when required).
Pass the resulting words JSON to legacy_recovery.py review. Audit selected word and neighbouring speech and confirm source video PTS before human approval.
Do not imply video production or mesh node deployment from 26/26 local regression tests.

provenance.claim: Exact standalone source and importer regression tests.
